review.tagline: Agent framework with a Linux desktop, browser and document editing
review.summary: Agent Zero runs an agent inside a Docker container with an XFCE desktop, a built-in browser with DOM annotation, and LibreOffice editing, all shown in a web UI Canvas. It adds projects with isolated memory and secrets, subordinate agents, a Plugin Hub, MCP and A2A support, and an A0 CLI connector for working on host files.
review.audience: Self-hosters wanting a Docker-isolated agent that uses a desktop and browser
strengths: Real XFCE desktop in the container; agent drives GUI apps and you share the mouse
Projects isolate files, memory, secrets, repositories and model presets per workspace
Prompts and tools are editable files; MCP, A2A and a 100+ plugin catalog supported
Time Travel snapshots and diffs the /a0/usr workspace so edits can be reverted
weaknesses: Requires Docker; default run maps port 80, which often needs remapping
Agent has shell and desktop access; README warns to isolate it and limit mounts
License is reported as NOASSERTION, so terms need checking before use
RAM and VRAM requirements are not stated in the README
needs: Models: OpenAI Codex plan via OAuth, Local models, API LLM providers
